# Roadmap: Solution Architect

## Role overview

Designs the technical solution for a specific business problem or project.

## Prerequisites

- [Java](../topics/java.md)
- [REST API](../topics/rest-api.md)
- Usually 8+ years of experience when hired

## Learning stages

### Stage 1: Core skills

- [ ] [Microservices](../topics/microservices.md)

## Also needed

Event-driven, TOGAF (optional), Draw.io, Lucidchart, C4 model, ArchiMate

## Where it leads

Grow: Enterprise Architect, AI Solutions Architect, Cloud Architect · Lead: CTO / CIO, Engineering Manager · Pivot: Pre-Sales / Solutions Consultant, Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)
